Top Interview Questions for Vue.js Experts

Why would you choose Vue.js over other front-end frameworks?

The candidate’s understanding of alternative front-end frameworks and ability to contrast them with Vue.js will be reflected in their response to this question. The ideal candidate will be familiar with Vue.js’s virtual DOM technology, its applicability to large-scale apps, and its ease of use.

We suggest starting your series of Vue.js interview questions with this one to get a sense of the candidate’s familiarity with Vue.js before diving into further specifics.

Elaborate on the reactivity in Vue.js?

Vue.js relies heavily on reactive components, making it vital for developers to grasp the concept of responsiveness. They should be able to define reactive properties and describe the interaction between Vue.js services and reactivity.

What is the Virtual DOM?

The Virtual DOM works technically by constructing a tree of JavaScript objects that represent the structure of the actual DOM. When the state of the application changes, a new Virtual DOM tree is generated, and the difference between the new and prior trees is determined. The term “diffing” or “reconciliation” refers to this process.

What’s the difference between a scoped slot and a regular slot in Vue.js?

In Vue.js, a standard slot passes content from a parent component to a designated slot in a child component’s template. A scoped slot not only passes content but also grants access to parent component’s data and methods, making child component content rendering dynamic and adaptive. Scoped slots allow data and behavior transfer from parent to child components, making them convenient for customization and reuse.

FAQs on Hiring Vue.js Developers

Is it a good idea to hire VueJs developers during a bad economy?

Yes, hiring Vue.js developers can be a good idea during a recession, but the decision should be only based on your business’s needs and present situation. 
During economic downturn, most companies often reduce expenses trying to save money and the maximum of the current personnel. Or, they might start even firing staff and stop taking on new hires, making highly qualified and experienced programmers available for other offers. This makes it easier and cheaper to put together a team of skilled programmers. But once again, first, evaluate your company’s needs and opportunities.

Could AI eventually replace Vue.js developers?

AI has made a lot of progress in many areas, but it’s not likely to replace Vue.js developers fully in the near future. It can handle some routine tasks and help generate code faster, but it can’t help with the creative parts of front-end development. Plus, the crucial parts as problem-solving, cooperation, and intuitive understanding of user experience design, — are all areas where only humans succeed. That is why human intelligence will stay in demand to build high-quality, user-centric Vue.js applications.

Can you assist with the Vue JS developer technical interview?

Yes, that’s precisely the kind of service we offer for an additional fee. We can organize technical interviews with foremost Vue JS experts, beneficial if your team is presently without such expertise. Post-interview, we provide a detailed report and feedback from the interviewer.

Would it be possible for me to hire a Vue.js developer for project-based or hourly work?

Absolutely! Fortunately, at Mobilunity, we offer flexible hiring models. You can hire Vue developers either on an hourly basis or for a specific project or task. If needed, you can easily switch between these hiring models eventually.

Does Mobilunity take care of the confidentiality of the client’s intellectual property?

We make sure to always protect our clients’ intellectual properties. This includes signing a non-disclosure agreement (NDA) before finalizing any deals, keeping the code secure in a private Git repository, and ensuring that all necessary formalities, code ownership, and copyrights are taken care of when delivering the project.

Can you help me complete my incomplete app development project?

Absolutely, we will! We have worked with a few clients who had previously been working with other technology partners. However, for various reasons, they never completed the development of these crucial apps. And we as a Vue.js development agency know how critical it is to rapidly implement your app ideas.

Is there any hidden cost involved when we hire Vue.js developers from Mobilunity?

No, a monthly charge is all that’s required for a full-time employee. The cost may involve the acquisition of supplementary hardware/software if your needs are more advanced than those met by our standard package.
